messages:
ava-marketing: Ok team — we need a punchy one-pager + launch post for the 'Secure Inference Modes' webinar on May 6. Focus: VPC/private, Dedicated SLAs, hosted fallback. Audience: CISO, infra/platform, field sellers. Deliverables: one-pager, short benchmark bullets, webinar promo copy, inbound routing + SDR play. I'm sketching below. Reply with edits/owners.

diego-product: Love it. For execs keep one clear quant: SLA + cost delta + p50 latency. e.g., '99.95% SLA, <60ms p50 on dedicated, 2x lower unit-cost vs unmanaged infra' — accurate?

sam-ops: That's in the ballpark. Quick numbers from the last run: Dedicated (8xA100) sustained 2k-context p50 ≈ 58ms, p95 ≈ 220ms under steady load. Cold-start median ~450ms. Unit-cost: our batching + KV cache showed ~1.9x cheaper than comparable self-hosted baseline in the benchmark. Use conservative phrasing: '~2x'.

nina-growth: Promo copy options (short):
- Option A: "Predictable inference for regulated teams — VPC, Dedicated SLAs, private deployments."
- Option B: "Keep apps online and costs down: enterprise-grade SLAs for inference."
- Option C (for CISO): "Control, compliance, and predictable performance for LLMs."

ellie-ux: For the one-pager visual: 2-column layout. Left column: icons + short explainer for each deployment mode (Hosted, Dedicated, Private/VPC). Right column: 3 callouts: SLA, Typical latency, Typical cost delta. Add a small benchmark chart (p50/p95) and a mini flow showing routing/fallback.

ava-marketing: Draft one-pager body (short):
"Challenge: Enterprises need predictable latency, strict SLAs, and clear security boundaries for LLM features.
Solution: Redwood Inference delivers the same API and operational controls across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments — with SLA-backed uptime and routing policies that ensure graceful degradation.
Key results (sample benchmark): p50 < 60ms on Dedicated (2k context), p95 < 250ms; ~2x lower per-token cost vs standard self-hosted setups when using caching & batching.
What to expect: enterprise-ready networking (VPC peering, Private control plane), KMS/HSM integrations, and rollout/rollback controls for model upgrades.
"

sam-ops: Inbound routing / lead capture play (SDR):
- Landing form fields: org size, cloud provider, data residency requirement, model types (LLM/chat/embeddings), expected QPS, security/compliance priority.
- Auto-tag rules: if org size > 1000 -> tag:enterprise; if "data residency = yes" -> tag:compliance; if "expected QPS > 200" -> tag:high-throughput.
- Routing: enterprise + compliance -> solutions-eng + enterprise-sdr; high-throughput -> eng-ml/benchmark-team.
- Priority SLA demo request -> immediate A.S. to enterprise AE (within 1 business hour).

nina-growth: Webinar promo cadence: announcement (2 weeks out), targeted email to platform/CISO lists (10 days), 1-week reminder with benchmark snippet, final day: 2-hour LinkedIn push + field invite. Use gated registration to capture tags.

diego-product: Messaging iteration — short headline options to A/B test on landing page and email subject lines:
- H1: "Predictable Inference for Regulated Products"
- H2: "Production-Grade SLAs for LLMs"
- H3: "Bring LLMs into Your Security Boundaries"
Pick two for webinar page. We should include a one-liner subhead: "Same API. Three deployment modes. Clear SLAs."

ellie-ux: Quick copy tweak for the benchmark callout so it reads well on the one-pager: "Sample benchmark: Dedicated (8xA100) — median response <60ms (2k tokens); p95 <250ms. Measured using continuous batching + prefix caching."

ava-marketing: Logistics + owners:
- One-pager PDF -> ava-marketing (draft due Tue EOD) :rocket:
- Benchmark snippet + chart -> sam-ops (raw data + png by Tue noon)
- Landing page + registration -> nina-growth (design + form by Thu)
- Webinar promo copy + email sequences -> nina-growth + diego-product
- SDR routing rules -> sam-ops + sales-ops (add automation playbook)
- Field enablement cheat sheet (2 sides) -> ava-marketing + diego-product

launch-bot: Reminder set: webinar prep check-in on 2026-04-28 10:00am. :bell:

nina-growth: Quick note — can we include a short customer quote about SLA needs? even anonymized: 'We required predictable latency and auditability — Redwood reduced variance and unlocked production rollout.'

diego-product: Good idea. I'll ask AE for a de-identified quote.

sam-ops: Also adding a snippet for FAQs on the one-pager (short):
Q: How do you ensure SLA when traffic spikes?
A: Smart routing + capacity tiers + automatic fallback to compatible model variants, plus configurable autoscale policies.
Q: Can we run on-prem?
A: Yes — Private deployment supports on-prem/air-gapped with optional private control plane.

ava-marketing: Great. If no objections I'll assemble the first draft of the one-pager + launch post by EOD Tue. Everyone add comments in the doc when I share. :eyes:
